categories.main_business_segments: Holy Stone primarily operates in the electronic components industry, focusing on the research, development, and manufacturing of passive components such as multilayer ceramic capacitors (MLCC), ceramic substrate metallization, active components, system modules, and other electronic components. The company also engages in wholesale and retail of electronic components and has expanded into the biomedical industry targeting medical biotech products.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company specializes in MLCC technology, ceramic substrate metallization, and advanced manufacturing processes including powder material development, high-temperature and high-voltage resistant capacitors, and low-loss capacitors for power applications. It emphasizes proprietary material systems, process improvements, and automation to enhance product quality and production efficiency, with ongoing R&D in high-reliability and niche products for AI, automotive, and industrial applications.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Holy Stone serves customers in the information and communication technology, consumer electronics, automotive electronics, industrial electronics, and medical biotech sectors. Its products are applied in smartphones, network communication equipment, industrial control, automotive electronics, solar energy, and AI server power supplies. The company actively targets emerging markets such as AI, 5G, electric vehicles, and data centers.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in Taiwan, China, the United States, and Europe, with a strong focus on expanding its presence in the Greater China region, Europe, and the Americas. It maintains a pan-Asian distribution and agency network and has subsidiaries in Hong Kong, India, and Shanghai to support regional operations.
categories.supply_chain_position: Holy Stone operates mainly in the midstream segment of the electronic components supply chain, manufacturing passive components like MLCCs and ceramic substrates, while also acting as a downstream distributor and agent for active components and system modules. It sources raw materials globally but is developing local supply chains to reduce risks and carbon footprint.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company prioritizes R&D investment in high-reliability, high-temperature, and high-voltage MLCC products, focusing on niche markets such as automotive, AI servers, and industrial control. It aims to enhance powder material production capabilities, develop low-carbon manufacturing processes, and expand product applications in 5G, electric vehicles, and medical electronics. Planned R&D expenditure for the next year is approximately NT$322 million.
categories.revenue_model: Holy Stone generates revenue primarily through product sales of self-manufactured passive components and agency sales of active components and system modules. It also earns from value-added system integration and solutions for customers, with a diversified product portfolio supporting multiple end markets.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company competes with major international electronic component manufacturers and distributors, particularly in the MLCC and passive component sectors. It maintains competitive advantages through niche product development, strong customer relationships, diversified product lines, and a focus on emerging applications like AI and automotive electronics.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In the latest fiscal year, Holy Stone reported consolidated revenue of approximately NT$12.786 billion with a gross margin of 16.34% and a net profit attributable to the parent company of NT$973 million, representing a 14.44% increase year-over-year. The company has shown steady growth and maintains a solid financial position with total assets of about NT$15.826 billion and equity of NT$10.379 billion.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Holy Stone emphasizes high-reliability, niche passive components tailored for advanced applications such as AI, automotive, and industrial electronics. Its value proposition includes proprietary material development, high-quality manufacturing processes, strong customer service, and commitment to ESG principles including green manufacturing and supply chain sustainability, differentiating it in a competitive market.
